description: Portal scaffolding plus the two genuinely-new backend flows and the static Help page (design Parts B, C, E). Adds config keys, the three applicant nav items, six routes, and the Business Profile / Settings / Help controllers, FormRequests, and views. This is the shared foundation FEAT-002's dashboard links to, so it comes first. Independent of FEAT-003 (tests). Covers cc-design.md sections 3, 4, 6, 7 and config section 5.1.
steps: config/permit.php: add 'renewal' => ['reminder_days' => (int) env('PERMIT_RENEWAL_REMINDER_DAYS', 30)] and a nullable 'support' => ['office_hours' => env('BPLO_OFFICE_HOURS'), 'office_address' => env('BPLO_OFFICE_ADDRESS'), 'contact_phone' => env('BPLO_CONTACT_PHONE'), 'contact_email' => env('BPLO_CONTACT_EMAIL')] block (all default null). Reference the window everywhere as config('permit.renewal.reminder_days', 30). No .env edit is required (the default guards an absent key); optionally add the keys to .env.example.

resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php: in the inline @php $nav block, extend ONLY the $user?->isApplicant() branch to append ['/business-profile','Business Profile'], ['/settings','Settings'], ['/help','Help'] after the existing ['/dashboard','Dashboard'] and ['/applications/create','New Application'] pairs. Flat [url,label] pairs only. Do NOT touch the bplo/treasurer/inspector/admin branches.

routes/web.php: inside the existing Route::middleware(['auth','role:applicant'])->group(...) block, add GET /business-profile -> BusinessProfileController@edit name 'business-profile.edit', PUT /business-profile -> @update name 'business-profile.update', GET /settings -> SettingsController@edit name 'settings', PUT /settings/profile -> @updateProfile name 'settings.profile.update', PUT /settings/password -> @updatePassword name 'settings.password.update', GET /help -> HelpController@index name 'help'. Import the three new controllers at the top. The top-level name 'settings' is free (admin's resolves to admin.settings).

Create app/Http/Controllers/Applicant/BusinessProfileController.php: edit(Request $request): View passes $request->user()->businesses()->oldest()->first() (nullable) to the view; update(BusinessProfileRequest $request): RedirectResponse does $business = $user->businesses()->oldest()->first() ?? new Business; $business->fill($request->validated()); $business->user()->associate($user); $business->save(); redirect back with a success flash. user_id via associate, never mass-assigned. One idempotent create-or-update endpoint.

Create app/Http/Requests/BusinessProfileRequest.php (App\Http\Requests namespace): authorize() returns true; rules mirror Business fillable — name/address/barangay/nature/ownership_type each ['required','string','max:255'], dti_sec_type ['nullable', Rule::in(['DTI','SEC'])], dti_sec_number ['nullable','required_with:dti_sec_type','string','max:255'], number_of_employees ['required','integer','min:0']. NO user_id, NO role.

Create resources/views/applicant/business-profile.blade.php: @extends('layouts.app'); one portal .card form with @csrf and @method('PUT') posting to business-profile.update; fields prefilled from $business or old(); empty-state copy when no profile exists yet; per-field @error.

Create app/Http/Controllers/Applicant/SettingsController.php: edit(Request): View renders the settings page for the authed user; updateProfile(UpdateProfileRequest): RedirectResponse does an explicit $user->fill(['name'=>.., 'email'=>.., 'contact_number'=>.., 'address'=>..]) of ONLY those four, $user->save(), redirect back with success — role/is_active never filled; updatePassword(UpdatePasswordRequest): RedirectResponse does $user->password = $validated['password']; $user->save(); $request->session()->regenerate(); redirect back with success. Mirror Auth\RegisterController for role safety.

Create app/Http/Requests/UpdateProfileRequest.php (App\Http\Requests): name ['required','string','max:255']; contact_number ['nullable','string','max:32'] (matched to Auth\RegisterRequest, NOT the ApplicationRequest regex; no messages() override); address ['nullable','string','max:255']; email ['required','email','max:255', Rule::unique('users','email')->ignore($this->user()->id)]. NO role/is_active.

Create app/Http/Requests/UpdatePasswordRequest.php (App\Http\Requests): current_password ['required','current_password']; password ['required','confirmed', Password::min(8)->mixedCase()->numbers()] with use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password; (pinned to Auth\RegisterRequest). Form supplies password_confirmation.

Create resources/views/applicant/settings.blade.php: @extends('layouts.app'); two .card sections — 'Profile information' (form -> settings.profile.update) and 'Change password' (form -> settings.password.update) — each with @csrf, @method('PUT'), and per-field @error. Note logout lives in the sidebar footer.

Create app/Http/Controllers/Applicant/HelpController.php: index(): View passes App\Support\PaymentMethods::all(), config('permit.municipality'), config('permit.province'), config('permit.valid_months'), config('permit.renewal.reminder_days'), config('permit.support').

Create resources/views/applicant/help.blade.php: @extends('layouts.app'); portal .card sections — BPLO office hours/contact (render each config('permit.support') value or a muted 'Not yet provided' when null, never fabricate), GCash manual-payment instructions (number/name from PaymentMethods::all()['gcash'], state the Treasurer verifies — never 'BPLO verifies'), a short FAQ in the real nine-status language, and tracking (BANSUD-YYYY-NNNNNN, /track 2-factor) + QR verification (/verify/{token}).
acceptance_criteria: php artisan route:list shows business-profile.edit, business-profile.update, settings, settings.profile.update, settings.password.update, and help all resolving to the new controllers.
config('permit.renewal.reminder_days') returns 30 and config('permit.support') returns an array of four keys (null when env unset).
The applicant sidebar renders Business Profile, Settings, and Help links; bplo/treasurer/inspector/admin navs are unchanged.

Business Profile saves create a businesses row with user_id set and never a role; Settings profile/password update the User without touching role; wrong current password is rejected by validation (behavior present, formally asserted in FEAT-003).
php artisan test stays GREEN at >= 154 passed / 519 assertions (no regression).
verification: Run with cwd "c:\\Users\\HP\\BUSINESS PERMIT_SYSTEM\\app": php artisan route:list --name=business-profile ; php artisan route:list --name=settings ; php artisan route:list --name=help — all resolve.
php artisan tinker --execute="echo config('permit.renewal.reminder_days'); var_dump(array_keys(config('permit.support')));" — prints 30 and the four support keys.
php artisan test — GREEN, baseline preserved.
findings:
DONE. Tests GREEN 154 passed / 519 assertions (no new tests here — FEAT-003 owns tests). Config: added config/permit.php 'renewal.reminder_days' (int env PERMIT_RENEWAL_REMINDER_DAYS, default 30) and nullable 'support' block (office_hours/office_address/contact_phone/contact_email from BPLO_* env, all default null). Optional keys added to .env.example. Reference as config('permit.renewal.reminder_days', 30) and config('permit.support').

Nav: layouts/app.blade.php applicant branch now ['/dashboard','Dashboard'],['/applications/create','New Application'],['/business-profile','Business Profile'],['/settings','Settings'],['/help','Help']. Other role branches untouched. Active-state is path-prefix based (unchanged mechanism).

Routes (inside existing ['auth','role:applicant'] group, no prefix): GET /business-profile -> business-profile.edit; PUT /business-profile -> business-profile.update; GET /settings -> settings; PUT /settings/profile -> settings.profile.update; PUT /settings/password -> settings.password.update; GET /help -> help. Controllers imported at top of routes/web.php (BusinessProfileController, HelpController, SettingsController). Top-level 'settings' coexists with admin.settings.

Controllers (App\Http\Controllers\Applicant): BusinessProfileController edit/update (user->businesses()->oldest()->first() ?? new Business; fill(validated); user()->associate($user); save; redirect route('business-profile.edit') with_status). SettingsController edit/updateProfile/updatePassword — updateProfile fills ONLY name/email/contact_number/address; updatePassword sets $user->password = plain (model cast password=>'hashed' hashes on assignment, matching RegisterController) then session()->regenerate(). Role/is_active NEVER filled anywhere. HelpController@index passes paymentMethods (PaymentMethods::all()), municipality, province, validMonths, reminderDays, support.

FormRequests (App\Http\Requests): BusinessProfileRequest (name/address/barangay/nature/ownership_type required|string|max:255; dti_sec_type nullable|Rule::in(['DTI','SEC']); dti_sec_number nullable|required_with:dti_sec_type|string|max:255; number_of_employees required|integer|min:0). UpdateProfileRequest (name req; contact_number nullable|string|max:32 per RegisterRequest; address nullable|string|max:255; email required|email|max:255|Rule::unique('users','email')->ignore(user id)). UpdatePasswordRequest (current_password required|current_password; password required|confirmed|Password::min(8)->mixedCase()->numbers()). No role/is_active in any request. authorize() returns true (group middleware enforces role).

Views (resources/views/applicant): business-profile.blade.php (PUT form to business-profile.update, Business-shaped field names name/address/barangay/nature/ownership_type/number_of_employees/dti_sec_type/dti_sec_number, prefilled old()/$business, empty-state alert when no profile), settings.blade.php (two .card forms: Profile -> settings.profile.update, Change password -> settings.password.update with password_confirmation; logout noted as sidebar footer), help.blade.php (office hours/address/phone/email render value or muted 'Not yet provided' when null; GCash number/name from paymentMethods['gcash']; states the Treasurer verifies payment, never BPLO; nine-status FAQ; tracking BANSUD-YYYY-NNNNNN + /verify/{token}). All extend layouts.app, reuse existing .card/.alert/.table-wrap/.data/.btn/.form-* classes; no new CSS.

For FEAT-002: nav + routes are live; business-profile prefill BRIDGE is still FEAT-002's job (ApplicationController@create must build an Application-shaped prefill object from Business — name->business_name, address->business_address, nature->business_nature; barangay/ownership_type/dti_sec_type/dti_sec_number same-named; number_of_employees ?? 0 — and pass as the _form-fields $application; add use Illuminate\Http\Request + use App\Models\Business). The 'settings' route name is the applicant settings page. For FEAT-003: formal assertions for business-profile save (businesses row user_id set, no role), settings profile/password updates (no role touched), wrong current_password rejected are NOT yet written here.
